text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All alone, deep in the mountains, there<n>lived a little
witch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She had trouble finding a use for her<n>magic. "Why
do I have these<n>powers?" she wondered.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
One night, she opened a picture book<n>about the
outside world and read it by<n>the moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Within its pages lay a whole wide<n>world, where
many people lived in<n>happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"They're having so much fun. I want<n>to go there
too."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch's little heart fluttered with<n>excitement.
She longed to see the<n>world outside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She began to think that if she used<n>her magic,
maybe she could make it<n>into an even happier
place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Night came to an end, and the morning<n>sun rose to
shine down on the<n>outside world.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch made a wish to bring<n>happiness to all,
and took a step<n>toward the world outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Mejiro McQueen<n>wins her
second consecutive spring<n>Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Practice with Team Sirius is getting<n>more and more
heated.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Another personal best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The energy on the track is palpable,<n>as the racers
push each other beyond<n>their limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've never seen a more focused<n>team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at the center of it all is McQueen,<n>with her
majestic running on full<n>display.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn, McQueen, I dunno how you do<n>it. Practically
ran a marathon, but your<n>pace and form are still
impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I bet there's not an Umamusume<n>alive who could
beat her in a<n>long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not wrong. You'd be hard<n>pressed to find a
stayer who could go<n>toe-to-toe with McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But a certain someone does catch my<n>eye...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But a certain someone does catch my<n>eye...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower, our newest member.<n>Unable to
perform well and stressed<n>out because of it, she
joined us in<n>rough shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy, Rice is all outta juice. Just<n>look at that
chin tilting up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, she can't compare to<n>McQueen. Not yet at
least. But what I<n>see is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, she can't compare to<n>McQueen. Not yet at
least. But what I<n>see is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A deadly gaze fixed on the target<n>running in front of
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a fighting spirit not even the<n>harshest
headwind can snuff out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And more than anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No... not yet... Come on, almost there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Didn't expect her to stay on my tail<n>quite this long.
But no matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And she does it again! Look at you,<n>setting record
times left and right!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wow! Just, wow!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's our Tenno Sho champion!<n>That's our ace!
Isn't that right,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: P-please, there's no need for such<n>flattery.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Solid running from Rice, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Wait, m-me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You looked about ready to pass out,<n>but you hung
on till the end.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if my running really is "solid,"<n>then why can I
never win a race?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In the Satsuki Sho, and in my last race<n>too, I tried so
hard only to end up in<n>eighth.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah but c'mon, you had McQueen<n>right in front of
you until those last<n>fifty meters. That's impressive.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I don't know...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What you need is confidence. Thefirst step is convincing yourself thatyou can run.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What you need is confidence. Thefirst step is convincing yourself thatyou can run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And, after running alongside you, I<n>can say with
confidence that there is<n>one other thing you require.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am referring to distance.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: D-distance?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's right. With your short and<n>slender frame,
plus those legs...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You're a natural stayer, no question<n>about it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You're a natural stayer, no question<n>about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm a stayer? The same as<n>McQueen...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yep. A longer distance will bring out<n>your potential.
Something longer than<n>your previous races, at least.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's a 2,400-metercoming up. Though the competitionmight be a bit... well, it will be tough.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's a 2,400-metercoming up. Though the competitionmight be a bit... well, it will be tough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Expressions grow serious as the<n>others realize
what I'm getting at.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is a special one for any<n>runner. A
once-in-a-lifetime chance to<n>stand at the top.
choice_data_list: Your next stop will be the Japanese Derby!
Your next stop will be the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-the Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her cry of disbelief lingers in the air.<n>But despite
how she may be feeling<n>about her future right now,
it's<n>looking bright and sunny to me.
